roadmap.title: First playthrough
roadmap.description: Play the story on any difficulty. Visit each optional spot in the order of the guide, shoot the balloons, try the Observation Deck exit, and gather every memo, echo and photo in this one run. Aim for the Maria ending.

roadmap.title: New Game+ run
roadmap.description: Start New Game+. Turn the radio off right away, take the chainsaw, and kill only with melee weapons. Move fast to finish in under 10 hours. Aim for the In Water and Leave endings by saving in the hotel corridor before the Red Pyramid Twins.

roadmap.title: Bonus endings
roadmap.description: In New Game+, pick up the items for Rebirth, Dog and UFO. Save at the Lakeview Hotel reception after the Music Box is solved, then reload that save for each ending. This can happen inside the stage 2 run.

achievements.description: Try to leave Silent Hill at the Observation Deck.
achievements.sortReason: Only possible at the very start of the game.
achievements.summary: Try to leave Silent Hill by walking back down the road at the Observation Deck area.

steps.text: Right after you arrive at the @loc{Observation Deck}, turn around and walk back down the road.
This is only possible at the very start, before you move on to the town.

achievements.sortReason: Opening story unlock.
achievements.summary: Enter the town of Silent Hill during the opening of the story.

steps.text: Play the opening of the story and walk into @loc{Silent Hill}.

achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Enter the Wood Side Apartments.

steps.text: Follow the story to the @loc{Wood Side Apartments} and walk through the door.

achievements.description: Shoot all the balloons in Wood Side Apartments.
achievements.sortReason: Needs a firearm while in Wood Side Apartments.
achievements.summary: Pop all 11 balloons hanging in Apartment 207 of the Wood Side Apartments with gunfire.

guide.context: Shooting balloons does not break the achievement for finishing the game without killing enemies with ranged weapons.

steps.text: Get the handgun from @loc{Apartment 217} first.
Go to @loc{Apartment 207} on the second floor and look for the Welcome Home decoration with balloons.
Shoot all 11 balloons with the handgun.

achievements.description: Enter the Otherworld for the first time.
achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Step into the Otherworld for the first time, which happens in the Blue Creek Apartments.

steps.text: Follow the story into the @loc{Blue Creek Apartments}. The Otherworld starts there.

achievements.description: Make your way out of Blue Creek Apartments.
achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Make your way out of the Blue Creek Apartments after meeting Pyramid Head.

guide.context: Pyramid Head leaves on his own when the timers end: 60 seconds in the first phase and 120 seconds in the second.

steps.text: Clear the @loc{Blue Creek Apartments} puzzles, then leave the building after the first @enemy{Pyramid Head} encounter.

achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Meet Maria for the first time.

steps.text: After leaving the @loc{Blue Creek Apartments}, follow the story to the pavilion by @loc{Toluca Lake} and talk to @npc{Maria}.

achievements.sortReason: Room 106 wall inspection is tied to the night segment.
achievements.summary: Inspect the wall of Room 106 at Jacks Inn at night.

steps.text: After leaving Brookhaven Hospital, wait for the night section of the story.
Return to @loc{Jacks Inn}, enter @loc{Room 106}, and inspect the wall.

achievements.description: Find the pizza in Pete's Bowl-O-Rama.
achievements.sortReason: Short side stop in the West side of South Vale.
achievements.summary: Examine the pizza on the table inside the bowling alley, Pete's Bowl-O-Rama.

steps.text: Once @npc{Maria} has joined you, walk to @loc{Pete's Bowl-O-Rama} on Carroll Street and examine the pizza on the table.

achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Arrive at Brookhaven Hospital.

steps.text: After meeting @npc{Maria}, go through @loc{Jacks Inn} and follow the story to @loc{Brookhaven Hospital}.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Flesh Lip boss in the Brookhaven Hospital Otherworld.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Brookhaven Hospital} until the @enemy{Flesh Lip} fight, then defeat the boss.

achievements.description: Survive the chase in Brookhaven Hospital.
achievements.sortReason: Story set piece in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Survive the chase through Brookhaven Hospital.

steps.text: Keep moving through the hospital until the elevator scene. The achievement unlocks after that scene.

achievements.description: Reach the end of the long staircase.
achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Reach the bottom of the long staircase after the Historical Society.

steps.text: Follow the story down the long staircase into @loc{Toluca Prison} and keep going to the bottom.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Abstract Daddy boss.

steps.text: Follow the story in @loc{Toluca Prison} until the @enemy{Abstract Daddy} fight, then defeat the boss.

achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Enter Pyramid Head's room on the Flooded Level of the Labyrinth.

steps.text: On the @loc{Flooded Level}, go up Ladder VI to reach the room where @enemy{Pyramid Head} stays and walk inside.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Kill Eddie.

steps.text: Follow the story to the @loc{Toluca Lake} freezer and defeat @npc{Eddie} in the boss fight.

achievements.description: Spend 10 minutes out on Toluca Lake.
achievements.sortReason: Only the boat after Eddie allows the idle wait.
achievements.summary: Stay on Toluca Lake in the boat for 10 minutes.

steps.text: After defeating @npc{Eddie}, board the boat on @loc{Toluca Lake}.
Do not row. Leave the boat idle for 10 minutes.

achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Arrive at the Lakeview Hotel.

steps.text: Cross @loc{Toluca Lake} by boat and walk into the garden of the @loc{Lakeview Hotel}.

achievements.sortReason: Story unlock in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Walk into Room 312 on the hotel's third floor.

steps.text: Follow the story through the @loc{Lakeview Hotel} until you reach @loc{Room 312} upstairs.

achievements.sortReason: Hotel kitchen visit before the hotel changes.
achievements.summary: Interact with the bread in the Lakeview Hotel kitchen.

steps.text: Use the @mechanic{Employee Elevator} to reach the @loc{Employee Section}, then go through the Cafeteria to the @loc{Kitchen}.
A @enemy{Lying Figure} patrols near the entrance. Wait until it walks toward the back right corner.
Run to the left side of the kitchen and interact with the bread.

achievements.sortReason: Story boss in campaign order.
achievements.summary: Defeat the two Pyramid Heads in the Lakeview Hotel Otherworld.

steps.text: Follow the story to the rainy staircase area of the @loc{Lakeview Hotel Otherworld} and defeat both @enemy{Pyramid Head} bosses.

achievements.sortReason: Final boss of the first playthrough.
achievements.summary: Defeat the final boss.

steps.text: Walk the long hallway to the end of the game and defeat the final boss.

achievements.sortReason: Chainsaw only exists in New Game+.
achievements.summary: Find the chainsaw in New Game+.

steps.text: Start New Game+.
After leaving the graveyard, go to the sawmill near the @loc{Silent Hill Ranch}.
Pick up the chainsaw from the logs on the right side. Its noise is audible from afar.

achievements.description: Finish off 50 enemies with a stomp attack.
achievements.sortReason: Passive counter, easiest on Creepers.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 downed enemies by stomping on them.

steps.text: Knock an enemy to the ground with a melee weapon.
Stand over the downed enemy and press the melee button to stomp. The stomp uses the same button as a melee hit.
Creepers (small beetles) are the easiest targets. A story room with the Creepers spawns them without limit.

achievements.sortReason: Passive counter with firearms.
achievements.summary: Kill 75 enemies with ranged weapons.

steps.text: Kill enemies with the handgun, shotgun, or rifle until the total reaches 75.

achievements.sortReason: Passive counter with melee weapons.
achievements.summary: Kill 75 enemies with melee weapons.

steps.text: Use the wooden plank, the steel pipe, or the chainsaw to kill 75 enemies in total.

achievements.description: Try to open locked doors 50 times.
achievements.sortReason: Unlocks naturally during the story.
achievements.summary: Pull on locked doors 50 times.

steps.text: Try locked doors as you play. The count rises on its own.
For a fast start, keep trying the locked women's restroom door near the @loc{Observation Deck}. Do it 50 times.

achievements.sortReason: Unlocks naturally during the story.
achievements.summary: Destroy 50 windows.

steps.text: Break house, shop, and car windows as you play. You can start once you have the wooden plank.

achievements.sortReason: Default-leaning ending, shares setup with In Water.
achievements.summary: Reach the Leave ending.

guide.context: Each main ending has a hidden score and the highest wins. Leave starts ahead of the other two, so avoid Maria and In Water points.

steps.text: At the end of the @loc{Wood Side Apartments} coin puzzle, use the Snake coin.
In the first @enemy{Pyramid Head} fight at the @loc{Blue Creek Apartments}, do not attack him. Keep away until he leaves.
Heal as soon as you are hurt. Healing a total of 600 points or more helps.
Kill 150 enemies or fewer in the whole run.
At the gallows puzzle, choose the justified prisoner whose story is the thief, the murderer, or the assaulter.
At the @loc{Lakeview Hotel} mirror puzzle, use the Rotten Apple.
Once both Red Pyramid Twins are dead, go through the Rust-colored Egg door.
In the long hallway, stay and listen to the whole conversation until she finishes crying after "Help me."
Before the final boss, inspect Mary's photo or letter in the inventory three times or more.

To earn both Leave and In Water in one run, use the Man coin in step 1 instead of the Snake coin, and play the In Water steps until you reach the corridor that leads to the Red Pyramid Twins. Save by hand there, then finish the game. Then load that save, take damage in the last two boss fights and heal right away, inspect Mary's photo or letter three times, and finish with the Leave steps from the Rust-colored Egg door onward.

achievements.sortReason: Recommended on the first playthrough.
achievements.summary: Reach the Maria ending.

guide.context: Each main ending has a hidden score and the highest wins. Maria starts behind Leave, so gather every Maria point listed here. Seven or more comments from Maria about going the wrong way or wasting time lower the Leave and In Water scores, which helps Maria.

steps.text: Do not inspect Mary's photo or letter in the inventory at any point.
At the end of the @loc{Wood Side Apartments} coin puzzle, use the Woman coin.
In town, take @npc{Maria} into the @loc{Auto-Shop Garage}, answer her question about her outfit at @loc{Jacks Inn}, and talk to her in front of the @loc{Baldwin Mansion}.
In town, ignore Maria's directions or stand around until she has made seven or more such comments.
In @loc{Heaven's Night}, inspect all 4 posters, the Sexy Nurse Outfit, the whiskey bottle, and the Lost and Found bin.
In @loc{Brookhaven Hospital}, talk to @npc{Maria} three times before you get the first patient bracelet. Talk to her once more after that bracelet and before you get the roof key.
In the @loc{Labyrinth}, visit @npc{Maria}'s room before the Rotten Area, after the Rotten Area, and after the Desolate Area. After she dies, leave the room and enter again.
At the gallows puzzle, choose the justified prisoner whose story is the arsonist, the kidnapper, or the robber.
At the @loc{Lakeview Hotel} mirror puzzle, use the Ripe Apple, not the Rotten Apple.
After the Red Pyramid Twins, leave through the Scarlet Egg door.
Do not wait to hear the whole hallway conversation. Walk on toward the final boss.

achievements.sortReason: Hardest main ending; score depends on health and choices.
achievements.summary: Reach the In Water ending.

guide.context: Each main ending has a hidden score and the highest wins. In Water starts behind the other two, so follow as many of the steps below as you can. If your health stays high, the Leave ending wins instead.

steps.text: At the end of the @loc{Wood Side Apartments} coin puzzle, use the Man coin.
In the first @enemy{Pyramid Head} fight at the @loc{Blue Creek Apartments}, attack him and deal real damage.
Do not heal right after taking damage. Wait until the warning icon in the bottom-right corner blinks, then heal. Do not die on purpose or reload a save to get health back.
Kill more than 350 enemies in the run, and stomp more than 30 different dead enemies.
At night after the hospital, go back to @loc{Neely's Bar} in the Otherworld and read the message above the jukebox.
At the gallows puzzle, choose the justified prisoner whose story is the thief, the murderer, or the assaulter.
At the @loc{Lakeview Hotel} mirror puzzle, use the Rotten Apple.
In the hotel basement before the final fights, kill all 3 weakened enemies: the Lying Figure, the Bubblehead Nurse, and the crawling Mannequin.
Once both Red Pyramid Twins are dead, go through the Rust-colored Egg door.
In the long hallway, stay and listen to the whole conversation until she finishes crying after "Help me."
Before the final boss, inspect Angela's Knife in the inventory at least two more times after you receive it, and inspect Mary's photo or letter three times or more.

achievements.sortReason: Four New Game+ items then the final boss is skipped.
achievements.summary: Reach the Rebirth ending in New Game+.

guide.context: Picking up the last book blocks every ending that needs the final boss. To keep the other endings available, solve the hotel's Music Box first and save by hand at the reception desk. Then finish the game once without the fourth book and once with it.

steps.text: Start New Game+.
Take the Crimson Ceremony Book from the graveyard, near the water, after meeting Angela.
Leave @loc{Jacks Inn} and take the White Chrism from the table in the doorway of the @loc{Baldwin Mansion}.
Take the Obsidian Goblet from the hole behind the missing painting in the main showroom of the @loc{Historical Society}.
In the @loc{Lakeview Hotel}, break the wall in @loc{Cafe Toluca} and take the Lost Memories Book from the Lost & Found room.
Finish the game. The Rebirth ending plays instead of the normal final fights.

achievements.sortReason: Two key parts and the Observation Room.
achievements.summary: Reach the Dog ending in New Game+.

guide.context: Solve the Music Box and take the 3F padlock key first.

steps.text: Start New Game+.
Take the first Dog Key part from the back room of the pet store on @loc{Neely Street}, north of @loc{Big Jay's}.
After leaving @loc{Jacks Inn}, take the second part from the dog house in the backyard of the first house on @loc{Katz Street}.
Combine the two parts into the Dog Key.
Upstairs in the @loc{Lakeview Hotel}, use the Dog Key to unlock the Observation Room. Do this instead of entering Room 312.

achievements.sortReason: Blue Gem inspected at four sites.
achievements.summary: Reach the UFO ending in New Game+.

guide.context: A strange sound plays at each of the four spots. If you hear it, the spot counts.

steps.text: Start New Game+.
Smash the display window at the Jewellers store on @loc{Neely Street} and take the Blue Gem. The store lies north of @loc{Big Jay's}.
Climb to the roof of the @loc{Saul Street Apartments}. Open the inventory and inspect the Blue Gem until it shines.
Inspect the gem on the pier in @loc{Rosewater Park}.
Inspect the gem on the pier of the @loc{Lakeview Hotel} garden.
Inspect the gem a last time in @loc{Room 312} of the hotel.

achievements.description: Complete New Game Plus on any difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: Needs a finished New Game+ run.
achievements.summary: Complete New Game+ on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish the game once to unlock New Game+.
Start New Game+ and play through to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the game without using the radio.
achievements.sortReason: Radio is turned off right at the start of the run.
achievements.summary: Play through the whole game with the radio never switched on.

guide.context: The radio is on by default. This can also be earned in New Game+.

steps.text: Take the radio from the house to the north of @loc{Martin Street}. Picking it up begins the first enemy fight.
Open the inventory right away and switch the radio off.
Leave the radio off for the rest of the game.

achievements.description: Kill at least one enemy with every normal weapon in a single playthrough.
achievements.sortReason: All five weapons are met on the story path.
achievements.summary: Get a kill with the wooden plank, handgun, steel pipe, shotgun, and rifle in one playthrough.

guide.context: The wooden plank is replaced by the steel pipe soon after you leave Jacks Inn, so use the plank first. The Armory Key lies in the Serpent Section, in a room just south of the Witness Checkpoint.

steps.text: Kill an enemy with the wooden plank, the handgun, and the steel pipe.
The shotgun sits in a locker of the @loc{Women's Locker Room}, second floor of @loc{Brookhaven Hospital}. Take it and kill an enemy with that gun.
Unlock the locked cabinet inside the @loc{Armory} at @loc{Toluca Prison} using the @item{Armory Key}. Take the rifle and kill an enemy with that gun.

achievements.description: Collect all the strange photos in a single playthrough.
achievements.sortReason: 26 photos must come from one playthrough.
achievements.summary: Collect all 26 strange photos in a single playthrough.

guide.context: All photos must come from one playthrough.

achievements.description: Finish the game in under 10 hours.
achievements.sortReason: Needs a fast New Game+ run with known routes.
achievements.summary: Beat the game with a clock time below 10 hours.

guide.context: With every key item and puzzle already known, a run takes about 2 hours 45 minutes.

steps.text: Finish the game with a clock time below 10 hours. A New Game+ run also counts.
Cutscene time counts toward the total. Menu and inventory time does not.

achievements.description: Collect all memos in a single playthrough.
achievements.sortReason: 68 memos must come from one playthrough.
achievements.summary: Pick up every memo within one playthrough.

guide.context: A default playthrough has 68 obtainable memos. In New Game+, the Cryptic Letter in the Pete's Bowl-O-Rama safe (code 1887) replaces the Lost & Found Note and Laura's Letter is not given, so check which run you are in. All memos must come from the same playthrough.

achievements.description: Finish the game without killing enemies using ranged weapons.
achievements.sortReason: Melee-only run, best with the chainsaw.
achievements.summary: Finish the game without killing any enemy with a ranged weapon.

guide.context: Firing a gun is fine as long as the shot does not kill an enemy. Shooting windows and balloons is allowed.

steps.text: Start a New Game+ run on Light Combat Difficulty.
Take the chainsaw from the sawmill after leaving the graveyard. Use only melee weapons for kills.
The chainsaw kills normal enemies in one hit and bosses in three hits.

achievements.sortReason: Awarded once the five classic endings are seen.
achievements.summary: Earn five endings: Leave, Maria, In Water, Rebirth, and Dog.

guide.context: The UFO ending is not needed.

steps.text: Reach the Leave, Maria, and In Water endings. The achievements Making Peace, Vicious Circle, and Only Way Out unlock along the way.
In New Game+, reach the Rebirth and Dog endings.
The achievement unlocks after the fifth of these endings.

achievements.description: Witness all glimpses of the past in a single playthrough.
achievements.sortReason: 26 echoes must come from one playthrough.
achievements.summary: See every one of the 26 echoes (the glimpses of the past) within one playthrough.

guide.context: Echoes can be missed if you pass a point of no return. All echoes must come from one playthrough.
